Polycab India Limited / Q2FY27 Earnings Presentation
Broad -Based Revenue Growth and Strong Earnings Delivery
4
▪ The Company delivered strong consolidated revenue growth of 53% YoY in Q2FY 27, driven by strong performance across all
segments and continued execution momentum
▪ EBITDA grew by 39% YoY during the quarter, supported by healthy margins in both W&C and FMEG businesses, improved
operational efficiency, and a favourable business mix
▪ PAT registered a growth of 43%, while PAT margin stood at 10.0 %. H 1FY 27 PAT increased 38 % YoY, with PAT margins at 9.9%

Cables
5

Polycab India Limited / Q2FY27 Earnings Presentation
Strong Execution Driving Continued Growth Momentum
6
▪ The W&C business delivered strong performance, registering 47% YoY growth during the quarter, supported by healthy demand
across government and private sectors . Both cables and wires grew strongly, with wires leading the growth momentum . Sales
across channel and institutional markets remained healthy .
▪ The international business grew 17% YoY during the quarter, contributing 5.0 % to consolidated revenue
▪ Margins improved ~90 bps QoQ to 14.2%. Sequential margin improvement was driven by operational efficiencies and a
favourable business mix

Polycab India Limited / Q2FY27 Earnings Presentation
FMEG Delivers Record Double Digit Profitability Backed By Robust Growth
8
▪ The FMEG business scaled new heights in Q2FY 27, with revenue more than doubling YoY to attain an all-time high quarterly
revenue of ₹9,931 Mn
▪ Growth remained broad -based across all product categories . Solar products continued to outperform, registering multifold
growth and retaining their position as the largest growth driver within the FMEG portfolio . All other categories also recorded
very strong growth during the quarter .
▪ Q2FY 27 marked a defining quarter for the FMEG business, with EBIT margins reaching a record 10.1%, underscoring sustained
progress in profitability

Highest Ever Second Quarter & Half Year
Revenue, EBITDA & Profitability
Results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026
▪ H1 FY27 Revenue at ₹ 1,81,086 Mn; up 46% YoY
▪ H1 FY27 EBITDA at ₹ 25,587 Mn; up 36% YoY
▪ H1 FY27 PAT at ₹ 17,867 Mn; up 38% YoY
▪ Q2 FY27 Revenue at ₹ 98,989 Mn; up 53% YoY
▪ Q2 FY27 EBITDA at ₹ 14,225 Mn; up 39% YoY
▪ Q2 FY27 PAT at ₹ 9,900 Mn; up 43% YoY
Mumbai, October 15, 2026: Polycab India Limited (BSE: 542652, NSE: POLYCAB) today announced its results for the 
quarter ended September 30, 2026.
Commenting on the performance, Mr. Inder T. Jaisinghani, Chairman and Managing Director, Polycab India 
Limited, said: “Q2 FY27 marked another quarter of strong execution and meaningful progress for Polycab. We 
delivered our highest-ever second quarter and half-yearly revenue and profitability, reflecting the strength of our 
market position, the robust performance of our Wires & Cables business, and the continued strengthening of our 
FMEG business. The domestic demand environment continues to be encouraging, supported by healthy 
infrastructure spending, increasing electrification opportunities, and improving private sector investment activity. Our 
international business maintained its growth momentum, despite an uncertain geopolitical environment. As we 
advance our Project Spring initiatives, we remain committed to accelerating growth, driving premiumization, 
deepening market penetration, and consistently delivering superior value to customers, partners, and shareholders.”
Key Highlights (Q2 FY27)
• The Company’s consolidated revenues delivered a strong 53% YoY growth to stand at ₹ 98,989 Mn. The strong 
growth was driven by robust execution across both Wires & Cables (W&C) business and Fast-Moving Electrical 
Goods (FMEG) business.

▪ The Wires & Cables business delivered a strong performance during the quarter, registering 47% year￾on-year growth, driven by a robust 50% increase in domestic revenues. Growth was supported by 
healthy demand across key end-user segments, aided by sustained infrastructure activity and strong 
execution on the ground under Project Spring initiatives. Within the W&C business, the wires segment 
continued to outperform the cables segment, while channel sales grew faster than institutional sales. 
The international business recorded a healthy 17% YoY growth despite a challenging global 
macroeconomic environment. Our diversified geographic presence, expanding customer base, and 
strong order book position the business well for continued growth. EBIT margins improved 
sequentially, supported by operational efficiencies and a favourable business mix. 
▪ The FMEG segment delivered another breakthrough quarter, with revenues increasing more than 
doubling year-on-year (+124%) on the back of strong demand across all key product categories. Solar 
continued to lead the growth story, reporting multifold expansion and retaining its position as the 
largest contributor to segment revenues. The quarter also marked a defining moment in the 
business's profitability journey, as EBIT margins surpassed the double digit threshold for the first time 
ever, reaching an all-time high of 10.1%. This achievement underscores the effectiveness of our scale￾driven growth strategy, enhanced portfolio mix, and sustained focus on operational excellence, 
positioning the segment for continued value creation.
▪ The EPC business demonstrated strong momentum, delivering 53% year-on-year revenue growth 
during the quarter. Segment profitability remained healthy, with EBIT margins of 7.2%. Backed by a 
healthy order book, the business is well-positioned to sustain growth.
• EBITDA grew by a strong 39% YoY and 25% QoQ, driven by sequential margin expansion across segments. 
Consolidated EBITDA margins improved by ~53 bps sequentially to 14.4%.
• PAT registered a strong growth of 43% YoY, with PAT margins standing at 10.0%
Key Highlights (H1 FY27)
• The Company achieved a significant milestone, with half-year revenues surpassing ₹180 billion for the first 
time. Revenue grew by 46% YoY to ₹1,81,086 Mn from ₹1,23,832 Mn in H1 FY26.
▪ W&C business revenues grew 44% YoY to ₹1,54,557 Mn from ₹1,07,641 Mn in H1 FY26, driven by strong 
momentum across both channel and institutional businesses. The International business contributed 
4.2% of consolidated revenue.
▪ FMEG business grew 97% YoY to ₹17,543 Mn in H1 FY27 from ₹8,897 Mn in H1 FY26

About Polycab
Polycab India Limited (PIL) is India’s largest manufacturer of Wires and Cables and one of the fastest growing FMEG 
companies with a consolidated turnover of ₹ 285+ Bn in FY26. PIL is at the forefront of providing innovative, safe and 
energy efficient products to a diverse set of customers via a strong distribution network of 3,900+ authorized dealers 
and 190,000+ retail outlets. PIL’s business operations span across India through 26 manufacturing facilities, 15 offices 
and 35 warehouses. PIL has also served customers in 94 countries globally. PIL’s 4,500+ employees are dedicated to 
upholding robust governance practices, preserving a customer centric culture, having a purpose to serve the 
communities, and imbibing a genuine sense of ecological consciousness. For further information, please visit 
www.polycab.com.
